factions.note: Emergent kmeans cluster on simulated-kit centroids in UMAP space. Post-Pareto LLM-driven cohesion clustering (hypothesis-flow § 1.7.8 Option A iter 5 lock) will produce ~3-5 LLM-named factions on the ~30 reduced kit population. This pre-LLM density structure surfaces the natural emergent neighborhoods for the cosmograph faction-halo rendering.
